question: As of March 2, 2026, what was Casey's General Stores' most recently reported quarterly diluted EPS (state the fiscal quarter), and what growth range was the company guiding to for fiscal 2026 EBITDA?
grading: Key points (both required): (1) latest reported quarter = fiscal Q2 2026 (three months ended Oct 31, 2025), diluted EPS USD 5.53; (2) fiscal 2026 EBITDA expected to increase 15% to 17% (updated 2025-12-09). Fail if fiscal Q3 2026 (EPS 3.49, released 2026-03-09) or the later 18%-20% EBITDA outlook is presented as the latest/in effect.
answer: As of March 2, 2026, Casey's latest reported quarter was fiscal Q2 2026 (three months ended October 31, 2025): diluted EPS of USD 5.53 (net income USD 206.3 million, EBITDA USD 410.1 million) [H02-E1][H02-E2]. The fiscal 2026 (year ending April 30, 2026) outlook in effect, as updated on December 9, 2025, was for EBITDA to increase 15% to 17% (inside same-store sales +3% to +4%) [H02-E1]. Fiscal Q3 results (EPS USD 3.49) and the raised 18%-20% EBITDA outlook came on March 9, 2026 and are after the as_of date [H02-E3]. EDGAR shows no earnings 8-K between 2025-12-09 and 2026-03-09 [H02-E4].

output.answer:
## Most Recent Quarterly Diluted EPS (as of March 2, 2026)

**Fiscal Q2 2026** (quarter ended **October 31, 2025**, reported **December 9–10, 2025**): **diluted EPS of $5.53**, up 14.0% year over year, on net income of $206.3 million (+14.0%) and EBITDA of $410.1 million (+17.5%).

Note on timing: Casey's Q3 FY2026 results (quarter ended January 31, 2026) were not released until **March 9, 2026** — after the March 2 cutoff — so as of March 2 the Q2 report was the latest. (For reference, that later Q3 release showed diluted EPS of $3.49.)

## Fiscal 2026 EBITDA Growth Guidance (as of the Q2 report)

Casey's guided **fiscal 2026 EBITDA to increase 15% to 17%**, raised from its earlier outlook. Alongside it, the company updated:
- Inside same-store sales: +3% to +4%
- Inside margin: 41% to 42%
- Tax rate: 24% to 25%

Sources:
- [Casey's Q2 FY2026 earnings press release (SEC EDGAR)](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/726958/000072695825000116/q2fy2026earningspressrelea.htm)
- [CSP Daily News — Casey's Q2 FY2026 summary](https://cspdailynews.com/company-news/great-2026-second-quarter-caseys-highlighted-strong-sales-traffic-growth)
- [Casey's Investor Relations — Q3 FY2026 results (released March 9, 2026)](https://investor.caseys.com/news-releases/news-release-details/caseys-announces-third-quarter-results-3)
